prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a rear-end collision. The patient had 3 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1116; do not mention it.)
text:
This is a synthetic test document. Treating provider summary for a patient presenting with right shoulder injury following a rear-end motor vehicle collision.

The patient was seen on three occasions for evaluation and management of right shoulder pain and restricted range of motion sustained after being struck from behind while stopped in traffic. At the initial visit, the patient reported immediate posterior neck and right shoulder pain, with pain worsening with overhead reaching and lifting. Examination showed tenderness over the right anterior shoulder, reduced active abduction and external rotation, and a positive impingement sign. Neurovascular status of the right upper extremity was intact. Plain radiographs of the shoulder showed no fracture or dislocation.

At the second visit, the patient was progressing with a prescribed course of anti-inflammatory medication, ice, and a home exercise program focusing on pendulum and gentle range-of-motion exercises. Pain was reduced, though lifting remained limited.

At the third visit, strength and range of motion had improved substantially. The patient was advised to continue the home exercise program, avoid heavy overhead lifting for several weeks, and return if symptoms worsened or new numbness or weakness developed. Prognosis for full recovery was described as good with continued conservative management.
